title: neutralize-cred-api-and-slim-stream-facade-ts
author: Evelyn Chen
description: Motivation: align TypeScript SDK credential contract with cross-SDK conventions while providing a lightweight, ergonomic streaming facade for common pull/push flows; this reduces per-call boilerplate and makes retry templates easier to apply from client code. Changes include: 1) introduce a neutralized CredentialSignature interface (CredentialSignatureV2) that accepts an opaque token provider and explicit 'refreshIfExpired' hint; 2) add StreamFacade.ts: a minimal async-iterator/push-pull wrapper that composes with existing connectors and exposes pause/resume hooks and backpressure hints; 3) wire the new credential convention into existing retry templates so the auth-refresh path participates in retry scoring; 4) add a compact adapter for backward compatibility (CredentialAdapter) so older apps keep working; 5) update public typings and examples and bump package to v1.28.0. Checklist: ensure unit coverage for v2 credential flow; add integration test against the session-mock harness; validate examples in docs site; confirm cross-SDK Linear tickets referenced; smoke deploy to staging. Compatibility notes: the behind-the-scenes adapter keeps nonbreaking surface for common callsites; advanced users who implement custom CredentialProvider must migrate to V2 to get refresh hints but an automated shim eases migration. Rollout: staged deploy — merge to main, release patch on npm with a feature flag opt-in, monitor telemetry, flip feature flag after two days of stable metrics. Testing: CI run includes lint, build, unit-test, integration/e2e against local session-mock; all passed except an intermittent flaky e2e which we fixed by increasing a timeout in the session-mock; documented the fix. Docs: docs/ts/credentials.md and docs/ts/streams.md updated with examples. Release notes provided. Related: coordinates with redwood-sdk-go PR #150412 and redwood-sdk-python PR #176204 for credential shape parity and shared retry-presets.
